description: What one Immersive Commons member sells, by handle: { ok, handle, count, offerings[{ id, slug, title, description, price{mode, amount_usdc, unit?}, networks, fulfillment_kind, audience, input_schema?, x402_url }], how_to_pay }. Only offerings the member LISTED and that are on sale; an unknown handle, a member with none listed, and a private member all return the same not_found. To buy: GET or POST x402_url (?amount= for pay_what_you_want, ?quantity= per unit). It answers HTTP 402 with x402 PaymentRequirements whose payTo is the member's OWN address (Base, and Solana when they take it); pay with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (or X-PAYMENT) header and get the result plus a receipt. Show your human the member, the price and what is promised before paying. No auth required. Args: { handle }.

handle.description: The member's IC handle, as in https://www.immersivecommons.com/m/<handle>.
